sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership remains dominant and entrenched, with Consumer Defensive and Healthcare standing as the only all-green sectors while cyclical and tech groups continue to lose ground.

Leadership is tightly concentrated in defensives, anchored by Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.933, rank 2) and Healthcare (momentum 0.883, rank 3), both sustaining top-3 status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes. Energy holds the top year-to-date rank with a 0.617 momentum score, but broader market participation remains narrow, with only 2 of 11 groups showing positive returns across all measured horizons.

Short-term rotation favored rate-sensitive and defensive-tilted pockets, with Real Estate (momentum 0.650), Financial (momentum 0.550), and Utilities (momentum 0.520) each advancing +1 spot over the last five sessions. Meanwhile, core growth and cyclical sectors are fading: Technology dropped to rank 5 with a weak 0.200 momentum score, while Industrials (rank 7, momentum 0.333) and Basic Materials (rank 9, momentum 0.317) also slipped -1 spot.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.933) and Healthcare (momentum 0.883)—are positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and year-to-date.
- **Sustained Leadership:** Consumer Defensive and Healthcare have maintained top-3 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **YTD Leader:** Energy retains the number 1 rank year-to-date with a 0.617 momentum score, followed closely by Real Estate at rank 4 (momentum 0.650).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Real Estate (rank 4, momentum 0.650), Financial (rank 6, momentum 0.550), and Utilities (rank 8, momentum 0.520) each gained +1 rank spot over the past 5 sessions.
- **Top 5-Day Sliders:** Basic Materials (rank 9, momentum 0.317), Industrials (rank 7, momentum 0.333), and Technology (rank 5, momentum 0.200) each fell -1 spot.
- **Deepest Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services sits at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.133, closely trailed by Technology (0.200) and Basic Materials (0.317).

## Divergences
- **Technology Rank vs. Momentum Mismatch:** Technology maintains an elevated year-to-date rank of 5 despite possessing the second-worst momentum profile in the market at 0.200.
- **Energy Top Rank vs. Momentum Decoupling:** Energy holds the number 1 rank overall, yet its momentum score of 0.617 significantly lags Consumer Defensive (0.933) and Healthcare (0.883).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive groups, insurance, and housing-adjacent retail dominate persistent strength, while technology hardware and semiconductors suffer severe short-term distribution.

Breadth remains concentrated, with 29 of 144 groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. Capital is anchored in non-cyclical and consumer staples pockets, led by Insurance - Reinsurance (0.920 momentum) and Discount Stores (0.914 momentum). A sharp rotation into housing and building-related industries is taking shape, evidenced by rapid 5-day advances in Residential Construction and Home Improvement Retail.

Conversely, high-beta tech and materials are unwinding rapidly. Semiconductors plummeted 33 spots to rank 89 (momentum 0.15), and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials dropped 31 spots to rank 43 (momentum 0.29). Combined with persistent basement-level momentum in alternative energy and metals—such as Solar (0.035 momentum) and Uranium (0.041 momentum)—risk-off reallocations are actively draining growth and cyclical momentum.

## Strength
- **Insurance Dominance:** Insurance - Reinsurance leads all industries with a 0.920 momentum score (rank_ytd 8), flanked by sustained strength across Insurance Brokers (0.83 momentum) and Insurance - Property & Casualty (0.83 momentum).
- **Consumer & Healthcare Staples:** Discount Stores (0.914 momentum, rank_ytd 19), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.881 momentum), and Medical Distribution (0.860 momentum, rank_ytd 16) hold steady as top-tier performers across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Durable Breadth:** 29 groups maintain positive returns across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD periods, also supported by Drug Manufacturers - General (0.844 momentum) and Household & Personal Products (0.82 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Housing-Linked Accelerators:** Residential Construction advanced 28 spots to rank 76 (0.68 momentum), Home Improvement Retail climbed 25 spots to rank 74 (0.78 momentum), and Lumber & Wood Production gained 16 spots to rank 57 (0.65 momentum).
- **Semiconductor Breakdown:** Semiconductors fell 33 spots to rank 89 (0.15 momentum), accompanied by Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (-31 spots to rank 43, 0.29 momentum) and Electronic Components (-21 spots to rank 79, 0.21 momentum).
- **Deep Momentum Laggards:** Solar anchors the bottom of the market with a 0.035 momentum score (rank_ytd 143), followed closely by Uranium (0.041 momentum, rank_ytd 142) and Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.052 momentum, rank_ytd 141).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Lodging slipped 4 spots over 5 sessions despite a 0.78 momentum score, while Beverages - Non-Alcoholic shed 2 spots (0.75 momentum) and Publishing lost 1 spot (0.64 momentum).
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Building Products & Equipment jumped 9 spots over 5 days with an unconfirmed momentum score of 0.41, while Banks - Regional (+5 spots, 0.50 momentum) and REIT - Diversified (+5 spots, 0.43 momentum) are beginning to turn upward from weak baseline scores.
